7350.title: Native transport failures leave requests pending
7350.rootCauseOneLine: Request/reply calls use a sender that swallows transport errors, leaving the promise and timeout pending after a failed send.
7350.proposedFix: Use a private throwing transport helper; reject and clean up failed requests while preserving non-throwing fire-and-forget posts.
7350.caveats: Repeated by the same agent in two clean trusted checkouts. Conditional transport failure reproduced deterministically; actual device navigation and failure frequency not tested.
